bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
head=fd5f32aa47e3c8559fe252244919bd736a267119
stage=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/reissue-invoice-$head
base=create-videobot:video-dualmode-button-download-dc4578de
new=create-videobot:reissue-invoice-$head
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 31
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$(docker image inspect "$base" --format '{{.Id}}')" || exit 32
git -C "$repo" fetch --no-tags origin feat/reissue-video-invoice-preserve-existing-buyer-20261124 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 33
test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$head" || exit 34
test -z "$(docker images -q "$new")" || exit 35
mkdir -p "$stage/src/runtime" "$stage/src/sales" "$stage/src/telegram" "$stage/src/operations" "$stage/sql" "$stage/test"
for file in src/telegram/videoInvoiceSales.mjs src/sales/pgVideoInvoiceOrders.mjs src/operations/reissueVideoInvoiceOffer.mjs src/operations/runReissuedVideoInvoice.mjs sql/023_video_legacy_purchaser_entitlement.sql test/videoInvoiceSales.test.mjs;do
 git -C "$repo" show "$head:$file" > "$stage/$file" || exit 36
done
docker cp "$cid:/opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorMigrate.mjs" "$stage/src/runtime/creatorMigrate.mjs" >/dev/null || exit 37
docker cp "$cid:/opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs" "$stage/src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs" >/dev/null || exit 38
python3 -B - "$stage" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
r=Path(sys.argv[1]);m=r/'src/runtime/creatorMigrate.mjs';s=m.read_text()
a="'022_video_invoice_fallback.sql'"
if s.count(a)!=1 or '023_video_legacy_purchaser_entitlement.sql' in s:sys.exit(39)
s=s.replace(a,a+",\n '023_video_legacy_purchaser_entitlement.sql'")
m.write_text(s)
p=r/'src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs';s=p.read_text()
import re
match=re.search(r"schema\.migrations\s*!==\s*([0-9]+)",s)
if match is None or int(match.group(1)) not in (21,22):sys.exit(40)
p.write_text(s[:match.start(1)]+"23"+s[match.end(1):])
PY
cat > "$stage/Dockerfile" <<'EOF'
FROM create-videobot:video-dualmode-button-download-dc4578de
USER root
COPY --chown=node:node src/telegram/videoInvoiceSales.mjs /opt/videobot/src/telegram/videoInvoiceSales.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node src/sales/pgVideoInvoiceOrders.mjs /opt/videobot/src/sales/pgVideoInvoiceOrders.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node src/runtime/creatorMigrate.mjs /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorMigrate.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node src/operations/ /opt/videobot/src/operations/
COPY --chown=node:node sql/023_video_legacy_purchaser_entitlement.sql /opt/videobot/sql/023_video_legacy_purchaser_entitlement.sql
COPY --chown=node:node test/videoInvoiceSales.test.mjs /opt/videobot/test/videoInvoiceSales.test.mjs
USER node
EOF
docker build --network none --pull=false -t "$new" "$stage" >/dev/null || exit 41
for f in /opt/videobot/src/telegram/videoInvoiceSales.mjs /opt/videobot/src/sales/pgVideoInvoiceOrders.mjs /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorMigrate.mjs /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs /opt/videobot/src/operations/runReissuedVideoInvoice.mjs;do
 docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$new" --check "$f" >/dev/null || exit 42
done
docker run --rm --network none -w /opt/videobot --entrypoint node "$new" --test test/videoInvoiceSales.test.mjs >/dev/null || exit 43
echo REISSUE_INVOICE_LEGACY_BUYER_IMAGE_READY_PASS
